name: KRC v0.5 — Context-Licensed Korean Clause Combination, Recoverable Ellipsis, and Event-Traceable Paragraphs
research_question: Can a bounded Korean realizer combine two source-licensed sequential events and omit a repeated overt actor while retaining fixed event reference and referent identity across a two-paragraph passage?
science_target: Actual Korean prose construction. No proposal voting, GAN score, or humanlike detector.
bounded_source: Two new assistant-authored controlled contexts EX13 laboratory and EX14 library with five fact records each and manually attested finite/coordinate Korean surfaces.

positive_operations.requirements: Immediately adjacent within same paragraph, both POS events, same explicitly declared actor, source SEQUENCE link, finite verb in first clause replaced with its prelicensed -고 form
positive_operations.result: One linked clause with two separately traced source events

positive_operations.requirements: Immediately prior discourse anchor has exactly one salient actor, current atom source actor agrees, one explicit antecedent, same paragraph, explicit ELLIPSIS_ALLOW link
positive_operations.result: Drop only source-licensed actor string; trace the omitted subject to original actor id

positive_operations.requirements: Result followed by separately sourced NOT_MEASURED fact and EPISTEMIC_LIMIT link
positive_operations.result: Licensed 다만 connective before intact second observation

prohibitions: Silently change event agent, argument, polarity, comparison direction, time or epistemic certainty
Join events without explicit temporal license as sequential
Perform subject omission after a third-party actor or impersonal event breaks the accessible antecedent chain
Claim that a compiled surface proposition is semantically equivalent to the source solely because of event ID equality
Introduce any new physical, affective or numeric facts
Claim general Korean fluency or better-than-LLM prose on manually authored microgrammar output

prospective_metrics.outcome: Actual four two-paragraph passages plus full source-event trace, mechanically tested, no LLM generator or independent reader involvement
